title: Numerical Gradient of f(x1..xn)
learning_objectives: Define partial derivatives and the gradient
Approximate each partial with central differences
Use the gradient in multivariable descent
entry_point: numerical_gradient(f, x, h=1e-5); gd_step(f, x, lr)
hints: For each i, copy x: `xp = list(x); xp[i] += h` and similarly `xm`.
`gd_step`: `[xi - lr * gi for xi, gi in zip(x, grad)]`.

failure_feedback.advice: Copy x before perturbing each coordinate.
Perturb only coordinate i; keep the others at their original values.
Subtract lr times each gradient component.
gd_step must return a new list using the gradient at the current point.
